units.sourceHTML: 2.1 Two Sample Input Files

units.text: Here are two sample files that we will use in numerous examples to illustrate the output of ⟦0⟧ and how various options can change it.
units.sourceHTML: Here are two sample files that we will use in numerous examples to illustrate the output of diff and how various options can change it.

units.text: In this example, the first hunk contains just the first two lines of ⟦0⟧, the second hunk contains the fourth line of ⟦1⟧ opposing the second and third lines of ⟦2⟧, and the last hunk contains just the last three lines of ⟦3⟧.
units.sourceHTML: In this example, the first hunk contains just the first two lines of lao, the second hunk contains the fourth line of lao opposing the second and third lines of tzu, and the last hunk contains just the last three lines of tzu.

nonProse: Command/flag literals and pure code/output examples retained; explanatory dt labels and italic pre descriptions extracted too; no unhandled prose text.
